routes.description: Per-entity-type route. Keyed by entity_type the extractor emits.

dst_template.description: Template of allowed substitution fields: {resolved}, {value}, {type}, {src}. Exactly one layer of enforcement: this schema's regex is authoritative. Literal { and } are not expressible (there is no escape form). Any {field} outside the closed set is rejected at schema validation time with the matching rejection at catalog-load time; the loader does not re-parse.

on_miss.description: Keep a link whose target is not loaded. On a resolver miss the edge goes to a node at endpoint_id, marked load_state not_loaded, and the retry row keeps waiting for the real record. Off unless a route declares it. The endpoint registers no alias.

endpoint_id.description: The target's real id. Only {value} may be substituted.

regex.description: Matched against the key; its first group is the scope value.

by_src_subtype.description: Route depends on the src node's subtype. Keys are snake_case live subtype names, PascalCase class names, or `_default`; values are simple routes.
